messages.subject: Why can't step into the "predict.nlar" function for debugging when using Revolution R Enterprise?
parts:
Dear Matthieu,
   I have modified "lstar" function for adding seasonal dummy variables and this modified "lstar" function is
successful for estimating coefficients for my "seasonal STAR" model.
   I have modified "predict.nlar" function in "predict.R" and "oneStep.lstar" function in "lstar.R" accordingly.
But when I used Revolution R Enterprise for debugging the modified "predict.nlar" function,the program
can't step into the break points in the modified "predict.nlar" function.
   Can you tell me the reason for this problem and give me some advice for resolving it?
   Best wishes!
                                                                                                                                         Sincerely,Wei Lili
